title: Big Red Newsletter [May 2026]
snippet: Congratulations to Cornell Tech Class of 2026!! Cornellians come from all around the world, learn AI in all its many applications (law, urban tech, health
extractedText: Big Red Newsletter [May 2026] Report this article Tony Chen Tony Chen Published Jun 15, 2026 + Follow 🐻📈 Big Red News 🐻 come to Cornell Reunion every year!! I really hope to see you!! everyone should come to every Reunion!!! 🐻 I am saddened by the passing of Thailand Princess Bajrakitiyabha Narendiradebyavati, LLM '02, JSD '05. she studied at the Cornell Law School, where she wrote her dissertation on the protection of the rights of the accused. 🐻 at Reunion, I met a Cornell Football Player, who is Reunion Clerking for the Class of 1971!! Cornell has the best football team, because of the amazing connection between all the players!! 🐻 at Reunion, I attended Professor Cindy Hazan's Retirement Party!! I took her class, Human Bonding, where I learned about Human Relationships, how babies bond with their parents, how romantic partners bond with each other!! 🐻 at Reunion, I went to the Master of Engineering party, a wonderful cross-disciplinary community of engineers!! One MEng!! everything from Computer Science to Engineering Management!! 🐻 Reunion Tent Parties!! it's 3 Big Tents on the Arts Quad: 1 with DJ music, 1 with Live Band, and 1 for Karaoke, and Cornellians everywhere!! I walk between the tents, try all the beer stations, eat cauliflower/broccoli, and chat with everyone!! 🐻 Cornell student found summer internship through the Cornell network!! he's interning at a math summer camp, and plans to become a math teacher after graduation! 🐻 Handmade Clocktower Pendants by Elyse Kantrowitz '00!! made of enamel with cloisonne and sterling silver bails, each one uniquely made, pin it to your dress, or wear it as a necklace!! for a wonderful Reunion outfit!! 🐻 Reunion is so busy, but I took some Alone Time to run around Beebe Lake, it was so peaceful, I saw birds, a rabbit, and so many trees 🐻 President Kotlikoff gave an incredible State of the University Address at Reunion!! the University had a lot of ups and downs in the past year, but it's managed so incredibly well by President K's leadership!! 🐻 Cornell Reunion is so wonderful!! so many Cornellians everywhere, so many new friendships!! it's the best way to make friends, to feel the sense of community!! 🐻 at Reunion, I always go to the Applied and Engineering Physics Breakfast!! I studied AEP at Cornell, it's such an incredible major, an incredible alumni community, you should study AEP too!! 🐻 at Reunion, the most meaningful event for me, is the Service of Remembrance in Sage Chapel. I remember the Cornellians who passed away in the past year 🐻 help Weill Cornell breast surgeon write a scientific research paper this summer!! Magdalena Plasilova is looking for summer researcher to help write paper on benefits of lumpectomies and mastectomies 🐻 Cornellian Office Tour!! I visited Fried Frank, an incredible law firm, one of the best in Fund Formation, for hedge funds and private equity funds!! 🐻 the NY State Assembly is an incredible legislature!! I visited the floor with Assemblymember Steven Raga, MBA '22, and I saw the budget getting passed, everyone buzzing around, with action and purpose!! I visited the Insurance Committee, and I watched Assemblymember Alex Bores '13 review and shape the most incredible insurance bills!! he's the most effective legislator in Albany!!! 🐻 I'm deeply saddened by the passing of Phyllis Weiss Haserot '65, I first met her on the Cornell Zoom Mixers during the pandemic, she ran the Inter-Generational Conversations breakout room, building Cornellian friendships across the generations 🐻 Cornell Hemlock Initiative saves the Hemlock Trees in NY State!! the Hemlock Woolly Adelgid (HWA) is an invasive bug, that eats the connective tissue of the Hemlock Tree, starving the new buds, killing the trees!! 🐻 I visited NY State Capitol's Hall of Governors!! 2 Cornellians were Back-to-Back Governors!! Horace White, Class of 1887, was NY Governor in 1910. John Alden Dix, Class of 1882, was NY Governor in 1911-1912 🐻 I visited the grave of John Alden Dix, Class of 1882, he was Governor of New York from 1911-1912, he was an incredible Governor 🐻 Cornellians are the best Roommates!! I just met 3 Cornellians who moved to NYC after graduation, and live together!!! I'm using AI to make a Cornellian Roommate Matching algorithm!! fill out the form below, and AI will match you with Cornellian Roommates!!! 🐻 Cornellians at the Hospital for Special Surgery!! the most incredible research in orthopedics!! medical device: new hips and knees! basic research: how bones regrow after surgery! 🐻 Cornell Class of 2025 has the most amazing events!! I learned a lot of gen z slang, Cornellians are the most amazing, friends over the years!!!!! 🐻 I learned about Menopause, at the Cornell Event in Westchester!! 3 Doctors presented to Cornellians in Westchester, about menopause and women's health!! 🐻 Cornellian is Mayor of Rye, NY!! the city is run so well, not one pothole, sidewalks smooth, flowers everywhere, in bloom!! with a vibrant downtow
